title: Kenyan Stew with Matooke
description: A hearty and flavorful Kenyan stew made with tender matooke and served with a side of hangover cure.

ingredients.name: hangover cure
ingredients.notes: used to add flavor to the stew

ingredients.name: tomato paste
ingredients.notes: used to add depth of flavor

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the kenyan stew spice and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the matooke, hangover cure, and vegetable oil to the pot.
Stir well to combine and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the matooke is tender.
Season the stew with salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
